instruction.text: You will hear an opinion about the use of artificial intelligence in daily life. Tick all statements that correctly reflect what has been said. Multiple answers may be correct.
instruction.sound: You will hear an opinion about the use of artificial intelligence in daily life. Tick all statements that correctly reflect what has been said. Multiple answers may be correct.

hint.text: Bei dieser Aufgabe musst du auf Details achten. Lies dir zunächst in Ruhe alle <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>Statements</lang> durch und überlege dir, welche Begriffe eine zentrale Rolle spielen. Das hilft dir dabei, genauer hinzuhören.
hint.label: Listen for detail

atoms.sound: I find it really scary to see how AI is everywhere now. And it's become so advanced and realistic, you can't trust photo or video evidence anymore. My friend's grandma almost got scammed on a phone call because someone faked his voice with AI and claimed to be him. Not to mention the detrimental effects on the environment. Huge amounts of water are needed to cool the data centers, and often, residents living in the area have to pay for all that water and electricity. I really don't think the benefits of AI are worth all of this.

b: ++The speaker talks about his thoughts on the dangers of AI.
++He states that it's becoming difficult to distinguish AI from reality.
His grandma was nearly scammed by someone using AI.
++He mentions that people living near data centers often have higher electricity and water bills.
Despite the dangers, the speaker thinks the benefits outweigh the risks.

instruction.text: You will hear an opinion about gender bias and parenthood. Tick all statements that correctly reflect what has been said. Multiple answers may be correct.
instruction.sound: You will hear an opinion about gender bias and parenthood. Tick all statements that correctly reflect what has been said. Multiple answers may be correct.

hint.text: Bei dieser Aufgabe musst du auf Details achten. Lies dir zunächst in Ruhe alle <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>Statements</lang> durch und überlege dir, welche Begriffe eine zentrale Rolle spielen. Das hilft dir dabei, genauer hinzuhören.
hint.label: Listen for detail

atoms.sound: I think it's unfair how women are expected to have children at some point in their lives. If a man decides not to have kids, it's usually met with understanding, but women?, We're told that we can't have a fulfilled life without being mothers. Having a child is a huge decision, and children deserve to be born into a loving family that can provide a stable and secure life for them. When people have kids they don't want just because they feel like they have to, it often leads to both the parents and the kids feeling miserable. Just because someone is a woman that doesn't mean they would be a perfect mother!

b: The speaker thinks that being a parent should be everybody's life goal.
++She claims that it is more socially acceptable for men to not want children than for women.
Not having kids will likely lead to an unfulfilled life.
Many people have children despite not wanting them, but they rarely regret their decision.
++The societal pressure for parenthood creates many unhappy families.

instruction.text: You will hear an opinion about foreign language education in American schools. Tick all statements that correctly reflect what has been said. Multiple answers may be correct.

hint.text: Bei dieser Aufgabe musst du auf Details achten. Lies dir zunächst in Ruhe alle <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>Statements</lang> durch und überlege dir, welche Begriffe eine zentrale Rolle spielen. Das hilft dir dabei, genauer hinzuhören.
hint.label: Listen for detail

atoms.sound: Foreign language education in the United States is a joke. I have a friend from Europe who already knows three languages, and is fluent in two of them! , Meanwhile, here, barely any of my peers know more than a few words of Spanish. It's really sad! I think multilingualism should be encouraged here as well. Learning foreign languages is a healthy brain exercise, and it's useful for many jobs, travelling, and interaction with more people than just English speakers. Schools definitely need more funding so they can employ passionate teachers willing to share their love of languages with their students.

b: ++The speaker thinks multilingualism should be promoted more in the US.
He talks about a study he recently read.
++He notes that language learning has positive impacts on the brain.
++The speaker mentions that multilingualism is beneficial in the job market.
He claims the problem is that teachers don't care enough about teaching languages.
